title: VHiCraft-v1 Inference Protocol

framework.name: VHiCraft
framework.full_name: Video Highlight Context-Aware Retrieval and Adaptive Framing with Temporal Stabilization

stabilized.description: full inference with TS-5 Revised temporal stabilization

unstabilized_control.description: internal control with TS-0 (CMP-1) instead of TS-5 Revised; only temporal stabilization differs

official_contract.bbox_format: [x, y, w]; derived h from targetRatioWH, no explicit h in JSON
official_contract.ordering: ascending frame within each video; videos sorted by id

C_fresh_qwen_inference.requirement: temperature=0, thinking=false; vLLM byte-level determinism is NOT assumed; structural reproduction gate applies

final_freeze_criteria.fresh_reproduction_pass: required for FINAL_CANDIDATE_V1; if fresh inference is not executed, status = READY_FOR_USER_EXECUTION

fs0_identity_requirement: prediction selection FS-0 must be a pure identity (frame ids, count, bbox, canonical JSON order)
stabilization_ablation_invariant: unstabilized_control vs stabilized differ only in temporal stabilization (TS-0 vs TS-5 Revised); frame ids, count, crop width, subject source and target ratio identical

corrective_preregistration.reason: Fresh inference had been declared but its generated output was not consumed by downstream components.
corrective_preregistration.timing: pre-result correction; no true fresh scientific result existed
corrective_preregistration.integration_resource_policy: Inference may run Qwen and RT-DETR on GPU upstream; TS-5 Revised itself remains the frozen CPU transform

scope: Full Dev166 fresh inference freeze: stabilized predictions and an unstabilized_control sharing the complete upstream with only TS-0 replacing TS-5 Revised.
